== v0.19 L5 (GH#335 items 2+5), APPENDED. Two surfaces that are PIXELS and were therefore invisible to every headless log in the suite until this wave gave each one an event. (a) THE FACED-INTERACTABLE BRACKET: shown only when the faced cell actually holds a present entity, so it can never promise an interaction that is not there. This run walked onto the pantry door and the bracket said so; it also crossed a cell facing nothing and said THAT, which is the half that proves the honesty (a bracket that were always on would pass a showing:true assert forever).

(c) THE COMPLETION STING (GH#335 item 4). Quest and class banks had a sound; every other counter banked in silence. `accomplishment_noted` is gated on count:1 -- the FIRST bank of a counter -- so it says 'that is new' and never turns into a per-hit combat rattle. WHAT THIS ASSERT DOES AND DOES NOT PROVE (v0.19 L5 reviewer lens A): this run banks FOUR count:1 counters (door_study_sleeps, door_awakened, catalyst_attunement_sleeps, resonance_grown) and exactly ONE sting is logged -- but the other three are eaten by the row's own 400ms cooldown_ms, not by the count gate, because a driven headless run collapses hours of play into seconds. So this is an EXISTENCE pin only. The machine-gun guard is the count:1 payload match in data/audio.json and nothing here measures it; a per-hit melee_hit tally is refused there, at the row.
